copy: A collection turns rows of data into pages — one page per row.
Slug pattern — /menu/{title} · Template — menu/_template · SEO title — {title} — Menu

targets.name: Content · collection-setup (modal) — step 1's Content type is read by nothing: contentType is declared at CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:112, rendered at :326 and never read by handleCreate (:168-227). The field row's drag handle draws a grab cursor with no drag handlers (:378). Five field types here (:47) against nine on the Fields screen (ContentViews.tsx:440), so the Slug field this wizard's own /{slug} default depends on cannot be created here.
